summary.en: Israeli air strikes in Gaza have killed a senior Hamas security official, his wife and children, and separately eliminated Hamas’s Gaza security chief, as well as Hamas’s internal security chief and a likely replacement. Israeli opposition members have advanced a probe into the October 7 attack despite Netanyahu’s opposition. The United Nations warned that the Gaza war has undone 77 years of human development and that the risk of atrocity crimes against Palestinians is widening. Winter rains are threatening about 1,000 Gaza shelter sites, prompting council warnings. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israels luftangrep i Gaza har drept en senior Hamas-sikkerhetsoffiser, hans kone og barn, og har separat eliminert Hamas’ sikkerhetssjef i Gaza, samt Hamas’ interne sikkerhetssjef og en sannsynlig erstatter. Israels opposisjonsmedlemmer har fremmet en etterforskning av angrepet 7. oktober til tross for Netanyahus motstand. FN advarte om at Gaza-krigen har tilbakestilt 77 år med menneskelig utvikling, og at risikoen for grusomhetsforbrytelser mot palestinere øker. Vinterregnet truer omtrent 1 000 Gaza-lyttsteder, noe som har ført til advarsler fra rådet. Konflikten har forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
